newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian counters up on US buying.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian counters up on US buying.

text.p: The Indian GDR market moved higher in London after demand from the US lifted some stocks higher, traders said.

"There was interest in State Bank (of India), Toubro and Larsen -- all the big stocks, like in the local market," said one. But he said foreign involvment has been subdued so far this year, with most of the running coming from local investors. Traders said the market is now in thrall to the forthcoming budget on February 28, with an oil price hike widely expected.
"The government is trying to talk up the market again," noted one, but interest was subdued.
The Bombay Stock Exchange's (BSE) benchmark 30-share index rose 53.80 points, or 1.56 percent, to 3,497.35 in late afternoon trade.
The Indian GDR index JCEAI closed at 69.35, up 1.19 points or 1.74 percent with the premium over the local market at 15.46 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended at 66.01 points, down 0.39 points or 0.58 percent, and the premium at 43.33 percent over the local market.
The Taiwan GDR Index closed at 103.32, up 2.43 points or 2.41 percent and a premium of 4.81 percent.
